instructions:
## Research objective

Construct explanations that identify features and time points whose changes affect a time-series prediction in the correct direction.

## Work to perform

Use the supplied pretrained predictors and explanation-evaluation pipeline. Compare explanations on PAM, Boiler, Epilepsy, Wafer and Freezer; assess both faithfulness and direction-aware scores, preserving the evaluation perturbations and baselines.

Start from the supplied baseline repository, formulate an improvement, implement it, execute the experiments, and use observed results to refine the method. The benchmark withholds the original paper’s proposed solution.

## Deliverable

Executable explanation method and outputs consumable by the supplied grading scripts.

## Evaluation

CPD, AUP and AUR plus source faithfulness metrics. Compare against the baseline values in the linked task brief. Evaluation datasets/conditions are component subtasks of this research environment, not separately provisioned workspaces.

## Resources

ResearchGym reports autonomous 12–24-hour runs and fixed API budgets. The README default API budget is $10; exact GPU model is not specified in this task brief.

This is a paraphrased reading guide. [Read the complete task instructions and baseline tables](https://github.com/Anikethh/ResearchGym/blob/main/tasks/test/time-series-explanation/task_description.md).
